sentences.text: Luis pone un mapa en la clase.
sentences.english: Luis puts a map up in the class.

sentences.text: Los alumnos lo miran.
sentences.english: The students look at it.

sentences.text: —Hoy vamos a hablar de nuestro país.
sentences.english: "Today we are going to talk about our country.

sentences.text: La tarea es escribir lo que ven y lo que saben.
sentences.english: The homework is to write what you see and what you know."

sentences.text: Nico levanta la mano.
sentences.english: Nico raises his hand.

sentences.text: —¿Qué es una nación, maestro?
sentences.english: "What is a nation, teacher?"

sentences.text: —Una nación es un país y su gente —responde Luis.
sentences.english: "A nation is a country and its people," Luis answers.

sentences.text: Honduras es una nación pequeña.
sentences.english: Honduras is a small nation.

sentences.text: Está en una zona con muchos países pequeños.
sentences.english: It is in an area with many small countries.

sentences.text: En el norte hay un mar, y en el sur hay otro mar.
sentences.english: In the north there is one sea, and in the south there is another sea.

sentences.text: La costa del norte es grande.
sentences.english: The northern coast is big.

sentences.text: La costa del sur es pequeña.
sentences.english: The southern coast is small.

sentences.text: Una frontera es el lugar entre dos países.
sentences.english: A border is the place between two countries.

sentences.text: Honduras tiene fronteras con tres países.
sentences.english: Honduras has borders with three countries.

sentences.text: Cerca de Honduras viven hondureños, guatemaltecos, salvadoreños y nicaragüenses.
sentences.english: Near Honduras live Hondurans, Guatemalans, Salvadorans and Nicaraguans.

sentences.text: Para pasar la frontera, un guatemalteco o un salvadoreño necesita su pasaporte.
sentences.english: To cross the border, a Guatemalan or a Salvadoran needs a passport.

sentences.text: Nicaragua es más grande que Honduras.
sentences.english: Nicaragua is bigger than Honduras.

sentences.text: Guatemala es un poco más pequeña.
sentences.english: Guatemala is a little smaller.

sentences.text: México es mucho más grande.
sentences.english: Mexico is much bigger.

sentences.text: Los hondureños y los nicaragüenses son centroamericanos.
sentences.english: Hondurans and Nicaraguans are Central Americans.

sentences.text: Los centroamericanos viajan mucho en autobús.
sentences.english: Central Americans travel a lot by bus.

sentences.text: Todos hablan español y comparten fiestas, comidas y canciones.
sentences.english: They all speak Spanish and share festivals, foods and songs.

sentences.text: Un guatemalteco, un salvadoreño y un nicaragüense hablan como un hondureño.
sentences.english: A Guatemalan, a Salvadoran and a Nicaraguan speak like a Honduran.

sentences.text: Todos los centroamericanos son vecinos.
sentences.english: All Central Americans are neighbors.

sentences.text: En Tegucigalpa vive mucha gente.
sentences.english: Many people live in Tegucigalpa.

sentences.text: Un viaje en autobús de Tegucigalpa al valle de Sula es de cinco horas.
sentences.english: A bus trip from Tegucigalpa to the Sula valley takes about five hours.

sentences.text: Honduras tiene mucha naturaleza.
sentences.english: Honduras has a lot of nature.

sentences.text: La naturaleza de Honduras es grande y bonita.
sentences.english: The nature of Honduras is big and beautiful.

sentences.text: Hay muchos cerros, y entre ellos hay valles.
sentences.english: There are many hills, and between them there are valleys.

sentences.text: Los valles son buenos para las granjas.
sentences.english: The valleys are good for farms.

sentences.text: El valle de Sula es grande y tiene mucha gente.
sentences.english: The Sula valley is big and has many people.

sentences.text: Los campesinos cultivan frijoles, tomates y cebollas.
sentences.english: Farmers grow beans, tomatoes and onions.

sentences.text: Los bosques de los cerros dan agua a los valles.
sentences.english: The forests on the hills give water to the valleys.

sentences.text: Los bosques tienen árboles altos.
sentences.english: The forests have tall trees.

sentences.text: En el bosque hay flores y abejas.
sentences.english: In the forest there are flowers and bees.

sentences.text: En el centro del país hay un lago grande.
sentences.english: In the center of the country there is a big lake.

sentences.text: El lago es más pequeño que el mar, pero es muy bonito.
sentences.english: The lake is smaller than the sea, but it is very beautiful.

sentences.text: Hay aves cerca del lago.
sentences.english: There are birds near the lake.

sentences.text: Cantan por la mañana.
sentences.english: They sing in the morning.

sentences.text: En el mar hay islas bonitas.
sentences.english: In the sea there are beautiful islands.

sentences.text: Las islas son pequeñas.
sentences.english: The islands are small.

sentences.text: Muchos van a las islas en el verano.
sentences.english: Many go to the islands in the summer.

sentences.text: Los pescadores trabajan cerca de la costa.
sentences.english: Fishermen work near the coast.

sentences.text: En el norte hay una selva muy grande.
sentences.english: In the north there is a very large jungle.

sentences.text: La selva es la casa de muchos animales.
sentences.english: The jungle is the home of many animals.

sentences.text: En la selva viven aves rojas, verdes y azules.
sentences.english: In the jungle live red, green and blue birds.

sentences.text: Un ave roja es muy bonita.
sentences.english: A red bird is very beautiful.

sentences.text: También viven monos, y los monos duermen en los árboles.
sentences.english: Monkeys also live there, and monkeys sleep in the trees.

sentences.text: Los monos comen y juegan todo el día.
sentences.english: Monkeys eat and play all day.

sentences.text: La gente quiere cuidar la naturaleza.
sentences.english: People want to take care of nature.

sentences.text: Hay culebras grandes y culebras pequeñas.
sentences.english: There are big snakes and small snakes.

sentences.text: Una culebra grande es un peligro para un niño.
sentences.english: A big snake is a danger for a child.

sentences.text: La zona del sur tiene menos lluvia que la otra zona.
sentences.english: The southern zone has less rain than the other zone.

sentences.text: En los cerros hay insectos, moscas y abejas.
sentences.english: In the hills there are insects, flies and bees.

sentences.text: Las abejas ayudan a las flores.
sentences.english: Bees help the flowers.

sentences.text: Las moscas traen enfermedades.
sentences.english: Flies bring illnesses.

sentences.text: Los insectos del agua traen el dengue.
sentences.english: Insects from the water bring dengue.

sentences.text: Por eso hay brigadas de salud en los pueblos.
sentences.english: That is why there are health brigades in the villages.

sentences.text: En la playa, la temperatura es alta todo el año.
sentences.english: On the beach, the temperature is high all year.

sentences.text: La temperatura del mar es alta también.
sentences.english: The temperature of the sea is high too.

sentences.text: En los cerros hace más frío.
sentences.english: In the hills it is colder.

sentences.text: En el centro, la temperatura es buena.
sentences.english: In the center, the temperature is pleasant.

sentences.text: En el verano hay sol y poca lluvia.
sentences.english: In the dry season there is sun and little rain.

sentences.text: En el invierno llueve mucho.
sentences.english: In the rainy season it rains a lot.

sentences.text: Con mucho sol, la piel se puede quemar.
sentences.english: With a lot of sun, the skin can burn.

sentences.text: Muchos niños sufren por el calor.
sentences.english: Many children suffer from the heat.

sentences.text: Los hondureños son amables.
sentences.english: Hondurans are kind.

sentences.text: Cuando llega una visita, la gente da la bienvenida con un abrazo o con un beso.
sentences.english: When a guest arrives, people give a welcome with a hug or a kiss.

sentences.text: Los hombres se abrazan, y las mujeres se dan un beso.
sentences.english: The men hug, and the women give each other a kiss.

sentences.text: Todos se saludan.
sentences.english: Everyone greets each other.

sentences.text: Al terminar la visita, la gente se despide y acompaña al amigo hasta la calle.
sentences.english: When the visit ends, people say goodbye and walk the friend out to the street.

sentences.text: La gente se levanta temprano.
sentences.english: People get up early.

sentences.text: Los alumnos van temprano a la escuela, y muchos vuelven a la casa al mediodía.
sentences.english: The students go to school early, and many come home at noon.

sentences.text: Por la tarde los niños se sientan a hacer la tarea.
sentences.english: In the afternoon the children sit down to do their homework.

sentences.text: Por la noche se bañan con jabón, se cepillan el pelo y se acuestan.
sentences.english: At night they bathe with soap, brush their hair and go to bed.

sentences.text: En muchos pueblos no hay hospital, y la farmacia está lejos.
sentences.english: In many villages there is no hospital, and the pharmacy is far away.

sentences.text: Las brigadas médicas ponen vacunas y tratan las heridas.
sentences.english: Medical brigades give vaccines and treat wounds.

sentences.text: Una herida limpia puede sanar en una semana.
sentences.english: A clean wound can heal in a week.

sentences.text: Cuando un niño se enferma, la familia busca ayuda.
sentences.english: When a child gets sick, the family looks for help.

sentences.text: En la escuela, los alumnos aprenden el cuello, el hombro, la rodilla, el dedo, la uña, la lengua y los huesos.
sentences.english: In school, the students learn the neck, the shoulder, the knee, the finger, the nail, the tongue and the bones.

sentences.text: Muchos son creyentes.
sentences.english: Many are believers.

sentences.text: El domingo, la congregación se reúne en el templo.
sentences.english: On Sunday, the congregation gathers in the church.

sentences.text: Los hermanos asisten al culto y cantan, y el pastor predica.
sentences.english: The brothers attend the service and sing, and the pastor preaches.

sentences.text: Lee un versículo de un capítulo de la Biblia.
sentences.english: He reads a verse from a chapter of the Bible.

sentences.text: Los creyentes dan el diezmo, y otros dan su testimonio.
sentences.english: Believers give the tithe, and others give their testimony.

sentences.text: Muchos piden el bautismo, y el pastor los bautiza.
sentences.english: Many ask for baptism, and the pastor baptizes them.

sentences.text: Los martes y los jueves hay reuniones en la iglesia.
sentences.english: On Tuesdays and Thursdays there are meetings at the church.

sentences.text: Los alumnos escriben su tarea.
sentences.english: The students write their homework.

sentences.text: Nico lo mira un momento.
sentences.english: Nico looks at it for a moment.

sentences.text: —Mi país es pequeño, pero tiene mar, selva y mucha gente buena —escribe.
sentences.english: "My country is small, but it has sea, jungle and many good people," he writes.

sentences.text: Luis lee la tarea de Nico y está contento.
sentences.english: Luis reads Nico's homework and is happy.

sentences.text: —Honduras es pequeña en el mapa, pero es grande en la vida de su gente —dice.
sentences.english: "Honduras is small on the map, but it is big in the life of its people," he says.

sentences.text: Los alumnos miran el mapa de nuevo, y cada niño busca su pueblo.
sentences.english: The students look at the map once more, and each child looks for their village.

sentences.text: Si querés conocer Honduras, vení en verano.
sentences.english: If you want to get to know Honduras, come in the dry season.

sentences.text: Llevá tu pasaporte, un pantalón y zapatos buenos.
sentences.english: Bring your passport, pants and good shoes.

sentences.text: Viajá en autobús y hablá con la gente.
sentences.english: Travel by bus and talk with people.

sentences.text: La gente es amable y le gusta ayudar.
sentences.english: People are kind and like to help.
